svg.aria-label: The three traditional regions of Tibet: Ü-Tsang, Kham and Amdo
svg.title: Chöl-kha-sum — the three regions of Tibet
svg.desc: Ü-Tsang, Kham and Amdo shown against the present-day map. Traditional cultural regions, approximated from current prefecture units; they are not present-day administrative boundaries. Territory administered by India, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh and Myanmar is excluded.
